name: Thandiwe Subramaniam
location: The Shelf — lower district tenements near the old lakeshore, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Thandiwe Subramaniam is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 28, she has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate her once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immu — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She arrived in GLMZ six years ago with nothing but chrome and debts, and has been working off both ever since. She works as a sniper out of The Shelf, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Thandiwe Subramaniam is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who she burned last.

core_fears: Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
core_desires: Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
coping_mechanisms: Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
psychology.secret: Zurab Watanabe-Amponsah murdered their mentor to take their position and contacts. It was staged as a job gone wrong. The guilt has calcified into something worse than guilt.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quiet and precise. Every word is measured. Silence does the heavy lifting.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
Uses old pre-collapse slang that nobody else remembers
example_lines: "Patience is the weapon. The rifle is just the delivery system."
"At this distance, the target is already dead. They just don't know it yet."
"One shot, one outcome. Everything else is theater."

story_hooks: Zurab Watanabe-Amponsah discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
A Tier 4 executive offers Zurab Watanabe-Amponsah a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A crew member from Zurab Watanabe-Amponsah's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
narrative_function: Zurab Watanabe-Amponsah is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks. Hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out

physical_description.heritage: South Asian dominant (56.9%) with significant Sub-Saharan African (21.7%) ancestry creates a striking phenotype. Northern European (6.7%), Hispanic/Latin American (5.7%), East Asian (5.4%), and Middle Eastern (3.6%) contributions add subtle complexity. The genetic blend manifests in warm deep brown skin with golden undertones, prominent high cheekbones from South Asian and African ancestry, and a strong defined jawline with slight base widening characteristic of African genetics. Eyes are deeply set with slight epicanthic influence from East Asian contribution. Nose shows South Asian structure with width influenced by African ancestry. Overall facial structure balances the angular prominence of South Asian features with the broader bone structure of Sub-Saharan African heritage.
physical_description.build: Stocky and compact with dense muscle distribution. Broad shoulders and thick forearms suggest functional strength rather than aesthetics. Her frame is built for stability and power delivery — the physiology of someone who uses her body as a weapon.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, naturally black with permanent sleep-deprivation graying at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid. No style for style's sake — purely utilitarian.
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with slight redness around the sclera from nocturnal living
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with golden undertones, weathered and sun-starved from six years of nocturnal operation. The base tone reflects the South Asian and Sub-Saharan African ancestry dominance (78.6% combined), appearing rich and deep with inherent warmth. Skin appears somewhat desaturated from indoor night work but retains the characteristic golden-bronze quality of the genetic blend.
physical_description.complexion: Strong jawline with slight widening at the base characteristic of Sub-Saharan African genetics, balanced by the pronounced cheekbones of South Asian heritage. Facial structure shows the high-set eyes influenced by both primary ancestries. Small scar through left eyebrow. Skin shows the warm golden undertones of her dominant ancestry but appears muted from indoor night work. Hands are calloused and scarred — burns from weapon heat, knife marks, impact trauma. Knuckles show old breaks, healed badly and never reset properly.
distinguishing_marks: Thin surgical scar along the right collarbone — synthetic lung installation point, partially healed over chrome edge
Deep laceration scar on left palm, running diagonally from wrist toward thumb
Burn pattern across the dorsal side of both hands — weapon heat exposure
Faint subdermal tracery visible under the skin of her inner forearms when tensed — possibly neural interface conduits
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome visible along the right collarbone and upper chest where synthetic lung housing meets organic tissue — industrial grade, not cosmetic. Faint metallic sheen visible in the skin around the installation. Knees and elbows show subtle mechanical articulation when she moves — hydraulic joints produce micro-vibrations visible in how her limbs absorb and redirect force. No attempt to conceal; the chrome is worn like a badge.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight distributed evenly, always balanced. Movements are economical and precise — no wasted motion. Her gait is quiet despite her stocky build; she moves like someone trained to not be heard. When sitting, she favors positions that allow rapid movement. Resting expression is neutral to hostile. Doesn't smile much. Eye contact is direct and held longer than is comfortable for most people.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working-class practical. Usually wears a worn black synthetic-leather jacket over grey cargo pants with reinforced knees and thigh pockets. Boots are military-grade lace-ups, scuffed and re-soled twice. Underclothing is functional — grey or black. A faded red hoodie for anonymity in crowds. No jewelry except a stainless steel watch with a cracked face. Her gear is maintained obsessively but never replaced for appearance. Everything she owns serves a function.
